description: Estimate the true cost of driving from one place to another: fuel or electricity, maintenance, tyres, tolls and optionally ownership costs (depreciation, insurance, registration). Best coverage in Europe. Returns EUR figures with a breakdown. Estimates use vehicle-class averages. Motorway vignettes for Austria, Switzerland, Czechia, Slovakia and Slovenia are included in tolls_and_extras (see the vignettes list); other vignette countries such as Hungary are flagged in warnings but not yet priced.

from.description: Start location, city or address. Include the country, e.g. "Munich, Germany".

fuel_price.description: Optional override: EUR per litre (or per kWh for electric).

fuel_type.description: Only for classes other than hybrid and electric. Default petrol.

premium.description: Premium brand: servicing, tyres and ownership cost more.

round_trip.description: Double the distance, tolls and costs.

name: calculate_trip_cost
title: Calculate car trip cost
